title: No existing customer, vendor or invoice changes at release
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Trucks Hill 2 on the production test account.
  • Before the release reached production, these were written down on production (with screenshots): customer {Customer-A}'s term and credit limit, vendor {Vendor-A}'s term and credit limit, and invoice {Invoice-A}'s term and due date, and vendor invoice {Vendor-invoice-A}'s due date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-02 Customer on Net 30 with $1,000.00, {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-02 Vendor on Net 45 with $2,000.00, {Invoice-A} is due Nov 4, 2026 and {Vendor-invoice-A} is due Nov 19, 2026.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the term and credit limit are exactly as written down.
  • Step 2: the term and credit limit are exactly as written down.
  • Step 3: its term and due date are exactly as written down (never re-dated).
  • Step 4: its due date is exactly as written down.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R2: “No existing customer, vendor or invoice changes term, credit limit or due date at release. The Counter Sale customer stays on COD permanently.”
  • S11-N1: “Nothing is moved, re-dated or re-sent to QuickBooks at release.”
  • S11-R13: “Due dates ShopView calculates after release use the calendar of the record's own location (S7-R6); due dates stored on existing invoices and vendor invoices are never rewritten (S7-E2).”
  • S7-E2: “Due dates already stored on existing invoices and vendor invoices are never rewritten. A screen that recalculates a due date from the customer's term shows the date on the calendar of the transaction's own location (S7-R6, S11-R14).”
  • Key Decisions: “Existing organizations keep COD as their default at release; organizations created after release start on Due on Receipt. No existing customer changes term.”
  • Key Decisions: “No feature flag. The feature ships to everyone; release-day behavior (Story 11: Release day) leaves existing shops exactly as they were until they act.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "9 Invoice due date", "1 List and row menus", "5 New Customer", "8 Over Credit warning" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
